Learning by

I’m Carl, a fourth-year Bachelor of Science in Information Technology student.

I have hands-on experience developing academic projects involving software, web, database, cloud, and IoT solutions. Through coursework and project development, I’ve worked with Java, JavaScript, C#, Python, SQL, and AWS.

I’m committed to continuous learning, adapting to new technologies, and contributing to practical solutions while strengthening my technical and problem-solving skills.
